metadata.description: ORTEX short-selling and market data for Claude.

plugins.name: ortex
plugins.description:
Better data. Better decisions. ORTEX's proprietary stock and financial data inside Claude, led by short interest: how heavily a stock is shorted, what it costs to borrow, days to cover and shares left to borrow, plus the ORTEX short score. Also options data, stock scores and peers, fundamentals, prices, earnings and macro calendars, US Congress trades and ETF data.

A bundled analyst skill shows Claude how to read short-selling signals together.

Read-only: ORTEX never places trades or moves money, and it does not give personal investment advice. The data available depends on your ORTEX plan.
